start.text: The last of the road comes over the brow of the moor, and the fog stops.
The fog thins in front of you all at once, like a door opening in a wall.
Not lifts: stops. It stands all round the crown like a wall, as high as you can see, and inside it the air is only grey, and the Hearthspire stands up out of the middle of it.
Pale stone, going straight up. You can't see the top from here. You put your head back and the shaft goes on into the grey and doesn't end.
All of it running down to here, Ness said. Like water to a drain. And the middle of a drain is dry.
On its east face, at the top of two worn steps, a door stands open a hand's width on the dark. Beside it, a little stone booth built out from the wall, with a seat in it.
